how_to_apply: Eligible candidates who wish to appear for the interview may apply online through a Google Form. The notice gives these steps:
Open the Google Form at https://forms.gle/xGw6KSk3LiwULZi37, or scan the QR Code attached to the notice ("Scan for Apply").
Fill up and submit the Google Form on or before 28 November 2026.
Watch your e-mail and the Institute website www.nita.ac.in for the interview date and time, which will be communicated to shortlisted candidates.
Bring the hard copy of the filled-in application form, along with supporting documents, to the interview.

important_instructions: No TA/DA shall be admissible for appearing in the interview. The Institute reserves the right to prescribe additional terms and conditions of engagement, which shall be binding on the selected candidate. All future announcements will be made through the registered e-mail ID given by the candidate and/or through the Institute website. content_sections.heading: NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Maximum 35 years as on 31-10-2026; retired personnel not exceeding 62 years may also be considered
One year initially, renewable annually; not more than three years in total

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The desirable qualification is a Postgraduate Qualification, preferably MD in General Medicine, or an equivalent qualification included in any of the Schedules to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956), with registration in a State Medical Register or the Indian Medical Register. The medical qualifications held by candidates should have the recognition of the Medical Council of India. Retired Medical Officers up to 62 years of age may also apply. The age limit for the NIT Agartala Medical Officer/Campus Doctor post is a maximum of 35 years, reckoned as on 31-10-2026. Retired personnel not exceeding 62 years of age as on 31-10-2026 may also be considered. The notice does not list any category-wise age relaxation. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.qualification: MBBS Degree or an equivalent qualification included in any of the Schedules to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (102 of 1956) with registration in a State Medical Register or the Indian Medical Register.
rows.experience: Candidates possessing relevant experience will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Medical Officer/Campus Doctor gets Rs.70,000/- per month consolidated . For official tours or visits, TA/DA will be admissible as per institute rules. No other additional perks or benefits shall be admissible, and no other service benefits, including benefits arising out of any past service, shall be admissible. The engagement shall initially be for a period of one year and may be renewed annually, subject to satisfactory performance and the requirement of the Institute. The total period of the initial engagement and subsequent renewals shall not exceed three years. The engagement is purely contractual in nature and for a fixed tenure. It is not against any sanctioned post. The selected candidate shall not be entitled to any benefits applicable to regular employees and shall have no claim for regular appointment, absorption, continuation or any other form of employment in NIT Agartala. The engagement may be discontinued at any time, without assigning any reason, if the exigencies of service so require or if the services of the incumbent are not found satisfactory or are no longer required in the interest of the Institute. Continuation of the engagement shall be subject to satisfactory performance, conduct and fulfilment of the requirements of NIT Agartala, as assessed by the Competent Authority from time to time. A selected candidate who wishes to leave before the contract period ends must give one month's prior notice or one month's consolidated remuneration in lieu thereof.

content_sections.text: Eligible candidates who wish to appear for the interview may apply online through a Google Form. Fill up and submit the Google Form on or before 28 November 2026. Watch your e-mail and the Institute website www.nita.ac.in for the interview date and time, which will be communicated to shortlisted candidates. Bring the hard copy of the filled-in application form, along with supporting documents, to the interview. Selection is through an interview. The date and time of the interview will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates through e-mail or notified on the Institute website in due course. The Appointing Authority reserves the right to cancel, modify or postpone the selection process or interview at any stage without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer/Campus Doctor posts has NIT Agartala advertised?
faq.answer: NIT Agartala has advertised 02 (two) Medical Officer/Campus Doctor posts, and the number is tentative and may vary depending upon the requirement of the Institute.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Agartala Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The Google Form must be submitted on or before 28 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NIT Agartala Campus Doctor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS Degree or an equivalent qualification included in any of the Schedules to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, with registration in a State Medical Register or the Indian Medical Register. A Postgraduate Qualification, preferably MD in General Medicine, is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NIT Agartala Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is a maximum of 35 years as on 31-10-2026; retired personnel not exceeding 62 years of age as on that date may also be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Agartala Medical Officer/Campus Doctor?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.70,000/- per month consolidated, with TA/DA for official tours or visits as per institute rules and no other perks or benefits.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the NIT Agartala Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Apply by filling up the Google Form at https://forms.gle/xGw6KSk3LiwULZi37 or through the attached QR Code by 28 November 2026, then bring the hard copy with supporting documents to the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the NIT Agartala Campus Doctor post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, with the date and time communicated by e-mail or notified on www.nita.ac.in.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Agartala Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual, not against any sanctioned post, initially for one year and renewable annually up to three years in total, with no claim for regular appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired doctors apply for the NIT Agartala Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Yes, retired Medical Officers up to 62 years of age as on 31-10-2026 may apply; they get the same Rs.70,000/- per month consolidated, and no service benefits arising out of past service are admissible.

faq.question: Q10. Will NIT Agartala pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA shall be admissible for appearing in the interview.
